newsitem.title: USA: Wallace Computer to buy Moran Printing.
newsitem.headline: Wallace Computer to buy Moran Printing.

text.p: Wallace Computer Services Inc said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to aquire Florida-based Moran Printing for cash and notes, and the deal was expected to be accretive to fiscal 1998 earnings.
Privately-held Moran had three facilities in Orlando and Tampa and generated sales last year of $41 million, the company said in a statement.
"Moran is an excellent fit with Wallace's commercial print strategy and gives us greater capabilties in the southeast," Bob Cronin, Wallace's president and chief executive said.
Wallace, which provides forms and consumable supplies management services, said it anticipated more geographic acquisitions.
